auth_files.account_settings_runtime_profile_hint_co: Resolved by the core for this account. Codex defaults to codex_rustls_native_v1, a uTLS replica of the real codex-rs rustls ClientHello (target JA3 e4d448cd), with core-managed headers and account-isolated transport.
auth_files.account_settings_runtime_profile_hint_ge: Resolved by the core for this account.

auth_files.account_settings_identity_rule_codex: Class A platform identity is pinned per account; Class B version markers use a source-backed high-water mark and never downgrade.
